A `scheduled` row with a `started…` annotation is not necessarily in flight: “in-train” is derived from the live worktree/PR view, not the annotation. If the named worktree is gone, the annotation is stale and provides no evidence that work remains active. [epoch0-main/docs/program/BOARD.md:22–35]

Grooming should add a note identifying the stale annotation, while keeping the row `scheduled`; it should not silently demote or delete the row. [epoch0-main/docs/program/BOARD.md:45–52]
